component.name: Matane Anime
component.summary: Open-source desktop anime player with a sandboxed extension system

description.p: Matane Anime is a desktop app for watching anime from sources you choose: a library with categories, watch progress and history, downloads for offline viewing, and alerts for new episodes.

The app does not host, store or distribute any content and ships with no sources. Sources come from extensions that you add yourself from repositories you decide to trust. The developers are not affiliated with anything that third-party extensions provide.
